reasoning_content:
The dev server transforms App.tsx and resolves the library to `/@fs/workspace/dist/formulardesigner.es.js`. Let me fetch that to confirm it's served and the CSS loading works. Also fetch the library file and the CSS.

The "file does not exist" is a benign warning (the lib is linked via file: and served from /@fs, not pre-bundled). Let's verify the actual served path.

action.command: cd /workspace && curl -s -o /tmp/lib.js -w "lib es.js: %{http_code} size=%{size_download}\n" "http://localhost:5173/@fs/workspace/dist/formulardesigner.es.js"; head -c 250 /tmp/lib.js; echo; echo "--- css import inside ---"; grep -o 'index.css[^"]*' /tmp/lib.js | head; echo "--- fetch css ---"; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "css: %{http_code} size=%{size_download}\n" "http://localhost:5173/@fs/workspace/dist/assets/index.css"
